notes.title: Hardware Compatibility Fix
notes.content: [p]Hello Explorers![/p][p][/p][p]VR Hardware compatbility has been on the top of our list to fix since the Steam VR launch of Dungeons of Eternity. This small update addresses this issue, namely issues with controllers and orentiation of hands in-game. Othergate would like to thank the users who helped beta test these fixes![/p][p][i]Couple Notes:[/i][/p][list][*][p]If you used any community bindings for your controllers, you may want to switch back to the game defaults. Additionally, if you were testing any of the betas, you will want to switch back to the default live build.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]If you'd like to manually adjust the angles, you can check the "adjust controller angles" settings menu.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188204/2f9a332bfa240c25fe807efd9fa99d26fb225ba9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188204/ed6c6db48379935043f5d83da417f9c406d243cf.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188204/5db4c07577f5b37b305d9716b8e2a0b8bc389a0f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188204/df43a15e642529e8a2bc14cc90a01a3ff7ac3d54.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]Another feature worth noting is a new checkbox in the Graphic Settings menu to sync the framerate and physics updates. At launch, this was defaulted to ON, which results in smooth gameplay when running at framerate. However, this could lead to a "slow-mo" experience if not running at framerate, which happened for many reasons (hardware differences, graphics not tuned, eye buffers too large, etc.) We have defaulted this to OFF for Steam VR, but [b]we recommend switching to ON and balancing your graphics settings for the smoothest experience[/b]! [/p][p][/p][p][i]Please refer to our Tuning Guide here: [url="https://www.othergate.com/steamvr"]www.othergate.com/steamvr[/url][/i][/p][p][/p][p]That's not all... the small update also features other fixes, improvements, balancing tweaks. More detail on those features in a follow-up Dev Post coming soon.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hardware Compatibility Hot Fix
notes.content: This is our hardware compatibility hot fix. Various issues fixed, potion prices re-adjusted, more information on this update coming soon.

notes.title: Next Hotfix Details
notes.content: [p]Hello Explorers![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for being patient with us as we work out the remaining launch issues. Below are the things still on our radar, and we're planning on fixing these in a patch within the very near future.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Graphics issues[/b]: we've confirmed and fixed the graphics with Radeon GPUs. If you run into other issues with specific hardware, let us know.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Framerate/performance[/b]: the most recent hotfix addressed the slow-mo movement. Since this fix, some users have reported other hitching and stuttering issues most likely caused by that change. So that some users can re-enable the 'buttery smooth graphics (physics framerate synced to render framerate)', we will be [b]adding an additional setting to the in-game Settings Menu that toggles the fix on and off[/b] according to your needs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller misalignment[/b]: this one is related to undetected hardware and mismatched controllers and headsets. For various reasons, that's on us, but a flurry of hardware orders and help from our friends at VR Monkey, we hope to have all this sorted out soon. Gratefully, community members have been patient and we were able to edit SteamVR bindings and offsets to 'fix' some of these cases. We're going to issue a permanent fix by updating the default developer bindings and offsets, and removing in-game hand alignment. [b]This will likely break anyone using a custom bindings file[/b] [b](sorry)[/b], you'll just need to reactivate the default developer bindings and copy the offsets to realign your controllers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Potion shelves[/b]: we have reports of the potion shelf becoming unreliable after some dungeon runs. We're addressing this to make it more reliable.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss tweaks:[/b] we will be making small adjustments to a few bosses for balancing purposes. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]There's also a couple of rarer issues that we're going to take care of.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Account linking codes[/b]: some users get codes with 0s and Os and find it hard to tell apart. The same thing happens with Is, Ls and 1s, and this needs to be fixed. We already added greater leeway to the code timeout; the in-game text says 5 minutes, but it's internally 10.[/p][/*][*][p][b]PSVR2 hardware[/b]: we have some PSVR2 kits and adapters coming in soon, and we'll get this officially supported with bindings and offsets.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Potion prices/gold economy[/b]: we raised the prices of potions based on the idea that everyone had a lot of extra gold. This obviously missed the mark, and we're going to lower them again. Hazard missions will also give out more gold.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Heads up - for those players who did purchase the game again on Steam (THANK YOU!) and have linked their Quest accounts, know that your previously purchased DLC is brought over as well. [b]As a thank you to these players, you also receive the Preorder DLC Armor[/b] when you link your accounts. Some players were not aware of this![/p][p][/p][p][b]We will need test cases for the controller and performance issues![/b] If you have either of those two issues, please post specs/hardware/linking method/settings in the comments. For players who were able to find a workaround, please describe the steps you took. If it's still broken, please describe what you did to try to fix it.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you![/p][p]Othergate Team[/p]

notes.title: Launch Day Hot Fix Update
notes.content:
This hot fix build contains the following fixes and improvements:

- Bloom (double image) and material fixes for AMD Radeon GPUs
- Physics now runs separately from rendering to avoid slow downs and "slow mo" gameplay when the frame rate drops

Thanks for your patience and support.  See you in the dungeons!

notes.title: Day 1 Issues - Working on it!
notes.content: [p]Hey Explorers![/p][p][/p][p]First - thanks to everyone who purchased the game on Day 1! The Steam version was a big effort for our small team, and we couldn't be more thrilled at the positive reception from the early adopters. Thank you![/p][p][/p][p]Given the complexity of VR development, a vast array of hardware differences, and DoE being a multiplayer game, there are going to be issues that slip through the cracks. This post is to let you know we are actively looking into the reported issues. The two big ones:[/p][list][*][p]Double-vision issue for Radeon cards (a fix is in testing)[/p][/*][*][p]Solutions for physics/framerate discrepencies causing slow-mo movement. Please read our Tuning Guide which will solve most issues: [url="https://www.othergate.com/steamvr"]https://www.othergate.com/steamvr[/url], however we want to find a solution that eliminates the problem completely[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you to the community for their patience and support. Continue to reach out to us on Discord (discord.gg/dungeonsvr) and through the Steam forums and report any issues you may find, and we will get the ones we can fix into a hotfix as soon as we can.[/p]

notes.title: Launch Date Announced!
notes.content:
[p]Greetings Explorers!

We're excited to announce that Dungeons of Eternity launches on Steam VR on [b]September 11![/b] [/p][p][/p][p]Check out the Launch Trailer - [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cr-FWbLoqa0"]Dungeons of Eternity Steam Launch Trailer[/url][/p][p][/p][p]The team at Othergate wants to thank everyone for their patience! We are a small dev team of 6, and when we set out to bring the game to PCVR, we wanted to do it right:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Steam VR Enhancements[/b][/p][list][*][p]PCVR visuals overhaul includes real-time lighting, high quality soft shadows, volumetric effects, ambient occlusion, extra detail, with graphic settings to tune to your liking[/p][/*][*][p]Cross-play between Meta Quest and Steam VR[/p][/*][*][p]Transfer Quest save to Steam[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Not only did we spend a ton of time enhancing visuals and polishing the game, we wanted to pair this release with our biggest update yet: the [b]Mythic Promotion Update![/b]   [/p][p][/p][p]Our last dev post covered some of the update's features: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3189340/view/510712444576858133"][/dynamiclink]But let's dive a little deeper into some of the new content:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Endgame Features[/b][/p][p]Promote your character and collect powerful Mythic Weapons! These weapons can unleash powerful charged up moves to let you blast through enemies like never before.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188204/daf2676fd03ff240bfb349507cb11636cd4e515e.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Vendors[/b][/p][p]We've shown the Merchant in a previous dev post, but here is a peek at the Armorer who will be smithing and dealing out hard-to-find weapons.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188204/3210ed991a93bfa7c7de62ae3c6648ef5a393e57.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Hazard Dungeons[/b][/p][p]This update introduces Hazards, which are [b]very challenging[/b] modifications to Dungeon Raid dungeon runs. Completing them brings great rewards, but it won't be easy. The hazards shown below are only a handful of the one's available to play.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188204/c38d608429b905e6bc39b8b6794d826f7efbb0ec.png"][/img][/p][p][b]New Chambers[/b][/p][p]Of course it wouldn't be a complete update without additional dungeon chambers. We've added over 30 new ones to the mix.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188204/451d2df50dce28b179e50c576aa6120acf9bbfd9.png"][/img][/p][p][b]LIV Creator Kit Support[/b][/p][p]Finally, a big feature we haven't mentioned yet is official LIV support! Recording your play sessions for sharing has never been easier. We have also added a "Selfie Mode" for capturing those post-dungeon-run moments with your friends.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188204/267cb7e38182268bad5bb9ce104d42236e9aacb5.png"][/img][/p][p]There are more features, content, and improvements not mentioned here.[/p][p]More details on pricing and bundles coming very soon!  [/p][p]We are beyond excited to bring the game to SteamVR. See you in the dungeons on [b]September 11![/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Dungeons of Eternity New Content Announcement
notes.content: [p]Greetings, Steam Community! 👋[/p][p]We wanted to give you a sneak peek at what we’ve been working on ahead of our upcoming SteamVR release. This isn’t just a simple port—our team has spent months enhancing Dungeons of Eternity across the board.[/p][p]The release is well on track for Summer 2025, and we're in the bug-fixing and polishing stage, so you'll get to start exploring the dungeons very soon![/p][p]The latest expansion - which will be simultaneously released on Steam - is called the Mythic Promotion Update, and it’s nearly ready. It marks the beginning of our Endgame content—designed to keep things fresh, challenging, and rewarding for high-level players.[/p][p]💥 A Proven Adventure[/p][p]So far, players on Quest—whether solo or fighting side-by-side with friends—have conquered more than 6 MILLION dungeons, defeated over 345 MILLION enemies, and hoarded upwards of 12 BILLION gold coins.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188204/df76f9ddcee8b282630ce8d17597675f8a3be371.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In the Soul Harvest game mode, they've freed the souls of 47 MILLION trapped enemies, and in Crystal Hunt, they've drained nearly 3 MILLION mana crystals to re-ignite Eternity’s dying sun.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188204/2c3131e813733df8a58e198a059f984f0b751f8f.png"][/img][/p][p]🛡️ The Next Chapter Begins[/p][p]With this update, a new communications array has been installed in the Outpost—your hub for endgame progression. Once you reach Level 60, you’ll gain access to Nova Guild promotions and unlock the fabled Nova Guild Armor as well as a new prestige rank.[/p][p]Rollover Mode allows you to retain your weapons, reset your level, and begin the climb again with purpose. Each rollover grants you access to one of nine all-new Mythic Weapons, each imbued with unique, chargeable powers. Choose wisely… or collect them all.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188204/54fa25f34ca88612ff7bd378bfc213be5c999005.png"][/img][/p][p]🛒 New Shops, New Loot[/p][p]Merchants have arrived in the Outpost as well, offering powerful gear and rare items that were once only found deep within the dungeons. Save your gold, or spend it wisely.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188204/105c179947d28bcf5061b9b56d8c690ce37031b1.png"][/img][/p][p]🧙‍♀️ Avatars Reforged[/p][p]Our avatar system has received a full visual refresh. You’ll now look even better while smashing through skeletons, slimes, and enemy hordes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188204/7187721d7fb9ce7ebde3b8294d9cab839c0c4fb6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]⚠️ More Hazards, More Rewards[/p][p]The dungeons of Eternity have grown deadlier—with new hazards like spider swarms and high-risk challenge modifiers. These make every run more intense… and the rewards that much sweeter.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188204/b49b762417436d815797eccb9a65c4b2259f6c90.png"][/img][/p][p]🧟 Boss Battles Reborn[/p][p]We’ve completely rebuilt boss encounters from the ground up to provide the epic, tactical fights players have been asking for. Whether solo or in co-op, you’re in for a serious test of skill.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188204/94641767975207e33d0490a03be954c207285703.png"][/img][/p][p]This is just a glimpse of what’s coming. We’re working around the clock to finish this update and bring Dungeons of Eternity to SteamVR soon.[/p][p]Stay tuned, Explorers. This is our biggest update yet. The Endgame begins.[/p]

notes.title: Dungeons of Eternity SteamVR First Look
notes.content:
[h1]Attention Explorers![/h1]

We’re excited to share a first look at the visual upgrades coming to the SteamVR version of Dungeons of Eternity! This trailer highlights enhancements like real-time lighting, volumetric effects, ambient occlusion, added detail, and more.

You’ll also have plenty of graphics settings to tune for a buttery-smooth experience.

So, what’s taken so long? You might spot a few surprises in this trailer. We didn’t want to just port the game from Quest, we’re launching it alongside our biggest content update yet!

Stay tuned for more teasers leading up to launch this summer.

🔖Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3189340/Dungeons_of_Eternity/

See you in the dungeons! 🗡️🛡️

WATCH IT HERE: https://youtu.be/urp9Tk9ZjJU
